llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit flow is implemented as a writable async Jotai atom action
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: submitAtom is defined as atom(null, async (get, set) => {...}), which is a writable async Jotai atom action

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Screen state includes separate atoms for draft text posts list and submit lifecycle
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Separate atoms exist for draft text (draftAtom), posts list (postsAtom), and submit lifecycle status (statusAtom)

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit action writes pending then commits success or error lifecycle state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: submitAtom sets statusAtom to 'loading' before the fetch, sets it back to 'idle' on success, and sets it to 'error' with a message in the catch block
evidence: set(statusAtom, { state: 'error', message: err?.message ?? 'Something went wrong' })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Successful mutation appends or prepends created post data and clears draft input atom
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: On success, the created post is appended to postsAtom via spread and draftAtom is reset to empty string

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit button triggers the async write atom through `useSetAtom` or `useAtom` dispatch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useSetAtom(submitAtom) is used to get the dispatch function, which is called in the Pressable's onPress handler
